sloka: मा भूत्ते विफला वाणी मत्प्रसादकृता शुभा ।भवतः पुत्रमेकं तु शूलमेतद्भजिष्यते ।। ७.६१.१४ ॥
transliteration: mā bhūtte viphalā vāṇī matprasādakṛtā śubhā ।bhavataḥ putramekaṁ tu śūlametadbhajiṣyate ।। 7.61.14 ॥

translations.english: May your auspicious words, granted by my grace, not be in vain; indeed, only one of your sons will possess this trident.
translations.hindi: मेरे और वसिष्ठ जी के सामने ( दशरथ ) से कही थी
